items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I mean when I was playing the alto saxophone he, Charlie Parker, Phil Woods and Gene Quill, they were I mean huge influences.

ctx.x: Well said. Let me run a few names by you. In addition to Fats Waller, Cannonball Adderley.

Wow. What can you say about Cannonball Adderley? Cannonball Adderley was huge and I don’t mean in a physical sense, I mean a huge part of my development growing up. I mean when I was playing the alto saxophone he, Charlie Parker, Phil Woods and Gene Quill, they were I mean huge influences. Wow. Just Cannonball’s sound and his time and his phrasing and his articulation and just, you know, how funky he was. It was, wow, what can one say about Cannonball Adderley.

It makes me think of — I mean I thought of him because you were talking about sound. And to me, his personality just like came out through his instrument. And it’s a good example of what you were talking about.
